name: sniveler-code.dev.burstnav-ecs
description: Zero-allocation navigation and pathfinding for Unity DOTS: flat A*, kinematic funnel steering and a static navmesh.

samples.description: Bake a navmesh and move one agent with flat A*.
Follow a path with kinematic funnel steering and a smooth corridor.
Stream 10,000 agents through a long walled field, pathfind them in batches and turn them around on arrival.
